register_custom_file_handler: use the register_handler decorator to register a custom BaseFileHandler subclass for new file extensions
register_handler_for_multiple_formats: register a single file handler class to handle multiple file format extensions at once
lookup_file_handler_by_extension: look up a registered file handler from the file_handlers dictionary by its file extension key
review_file_handlers_registry: review the file_handlers dictionary to see which handlers are registered for json, yaml, yml, pickle, and pkl extensions
summarize_register_handler_decorator: summarize how the register_handler decorator instantiates a handler class with kwargs and registers it for given file formats
